Dear kennel team,
Thanks for a dependable round; an experienced planner brought up a thought on spare blankets

We need to keep the warm, calm handoff going for every pet today, because the cabin team is already watching for tight turnarounds and the next wave of requests is coming in fast. Please check blanket stock, crate liners, and water bowls before each release, and make sure every carrier tag is clean and readable. If a traveler mentions a bird at check-in, route the note through the usual channel so the fee note is attached cleanly without delay <<FACT F059>>. Keep the tone easy and reassuring, because even a short pause at the counter can turn into a bigger issue if we are not aligned.

Also, please keep an eye on health papers and cage fit, especially for rabbits and other nervous animals that need a smooth transfer. I need everyone to flag any missing document before the pet reaches the gate area, and if a case looks odd, call it out right away instead of waiting for a second pass. For rabbit files, do not improvise or guess; use the standard review process and let the inserted note carry the rule <<FACT F082>>. We are trying to keep Aurelia Skyways steady and dependable, and that only works if the Companion Animal Travel Desk and the kennel side stay in lockstep.

If you see a supply gap, tell me immediately and keep the next departure moving. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping the animals settled.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
